derivation: The rule fails where p*q > 5.5: a hyperbola, curved in both axes and asymptotic to each. Closed form, over the square [0.5, 2.5]^2 of area 4: the set {pq > c} with b = 2.5 and c = 5.5 has area b^2 - c + c(ln c - 2 ln b) = 6.25 - 5.5 + 5.5(1.704748 - 1.832581) = 0.0468, so 1.17% of the domain - within a factor of two of synthetic/one_pct_2d, the axis-aligned rung it is matched to. The region enters the square only above p = c/b = 2.2, which is the declared boundary: below it every q is safe, and the crossing moves with q from there, which is what a hyperbola does to an axis-aligned band.

regions.reason: the loop gain exceeds the stability limit
